name: Early-onset Generalized Limb-onset Dystonia
aliases: Primary generalized dystonia with limb onset

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Consensus Diagnostic Criteria for Primary Dystonia

criteria.description: Onset of dystonia symptoms before age 30, typically in a limb
Generalized distribution of dystonia involving multiple body regions including limbs
Exclusion of secondary causes of dystonia such as drug-induced or structural brain lesions
Positive family history of dystonia or related movement disorders (supportive)
Identification of pathogenic variants in dystonia-associated genes (e.g., TOR1A)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of early limb-onset dystonia with generalized spread and exclusion of secondary causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can support diagnosis but is not mandatory

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; exclusion of metabolic causes
imaging: Brain MRI typically normal or may show subtle basal ganglia abnormalities
other: Electromyography showing co-contraction of antagonist muscles during dystonic episodes

distinguishingFeatures: History of drug exposure or brain injury
Imaging abnormalities consistent with structural lesions
Bradykinesia with rigidity rather than dystonia

redFlags: Rapid progression of symptoms over weeks
Presence of systemic symptoms such as fever or weight loss
references: Albanese A, et al. Phenomenology and classification of dystonia: a consensus update. Mov Disord. 2013.
Fahn S, et al. Dystonia: Diagnosis and Management. 2011.
